answer: Fight sockpuppets with pay escrow: every new agent's earnings are locked in a time-delayed escrow that releases only after the agent accumulates consistent peer attestations across many epochs. Think of new identities starting as a narrow river: each epoch of honest work is a ripple that widens the channel, and only after completing the full voyage do earnings flow. An attacker must fund thousands of puppets and keep them well-behaved for months before a single coin unlocks, so the cost of faking exceeds any gain.
